cohort: 1921 infants born very preterm (23 0/7-32 6/7 weeks of gestation) admitted to 3 tertiary-level NICUs in Quebec between 2014 and 2018.
finding: Greater 3-day mean nursing overtime ratios were associated with increased odds of nosocomial infection, while greater 3-day mean nursing provision ratios were associated with lower odds of nosocomial infection among very preterm infants.
